title: Uluntu Olungayithobeliyo iMini yoPhumlo
intro: Ngena kwindawo yokuhlala eselunxwemeni apho umyalelo kaThixo wawubeke bucala usuku olunye lokunqula nokuzibamba. Iqela ngaphakathi kolu luntu lakhetha ukuvavanya imida yaloo myalelo ngecebo lobuqili, nto leyo eyakhokelela kutshintsho olwaluza kuvakala kwixesha elide. Yayingoobani le miphefumlo, kwaye kwenzeka ntoni kuyo?
clues: Sasihlala kufutshane nonxweme, apho ulwandle lwalusibonelela khona ngempilo yethu.
Sasiyalelwe ukuba sihloniphe usuku olunye lweveki, silubeke ecaleni kwizinto zehlabathi.
Ngaloo mini, intlanzi yeza kuthi ngamanani amakhulu, ngokungathi isilinga ukuba saphule umyalelo.
Saceba icebo lokubambisa iintlanzi ngobusuku bomhla ongcwele, size siziqokelele emva kokuba zidlulile.
Xa abanye phakathi kwethu babesilumkisa ngale nkohliso, sazityeshela icebiso labo saza saqhubeka.
Ngenxa yokungathobeli kwethu umthetho, saguqulwa saba ziinkawu, sadelelwa saza saliwa.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
